about: Launch photographs of missiles in their boost, measured with measure.py (2026-10-09): Wikimedia Commons files, U.S. government works (public domain); not kept in the repository. 'nozzle' and 'nose' are the points measured from, in the full-size file's pixels; diameter and length are the missile's (m). The AIM-120 at dusk (F-14A AIM-120 Test 2.JPEG) is read by eye only - an aircraft behind its plume spoils the sky beside it: a bright orange flame some 0.75 L long, saturated in its long exposure. 'F-22 fires AIM-9M Sidewinder ... March 2005.jpg' shows the missile still on its launcher, its flame on the launcher: not a free plume, left out.
